import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

# Billiards with VERTICAL component: rays can go up/down/left/right, reflect off edges; stop at line.
def bounce(I,d,dirs):
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0])

def f(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    L=max([r for r in range(H) if inp[r].count(2)==W],default=None)
    out=[row[:] for row in inp]
    dots=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if inp[r][c]==4]
    for r,c in dots: out[r][c]=0
    # every dot drops one step down (vertical gravity)
    for d in dots: out[d[0]+1][d[1]]=4
    # each dot above the line at distance<=2 also sprouts a downward-opening X (vertex at dot+down1),
    # arms slope ±1 going upward, clipped by edges
    for d in dots:
        r,c=d
        if r<L and L-r-1<=2:
            ar,ac=r+1,c
            out[ar][ac]=4
            k=1
            while True:
                p1=(ar-k,ac-k); p2=(ar-k,ac+k)
                if p1[0]<0 and p2[0]<0: break
                for p in (p1,p2):
                    if 0<=p[0]<H and 0<=p[1]<W: out[p[0]][p[1]]=4
                k+=1
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
